description: Horizontal padding, border and margin of a span sit in the line without breaking it; vertical ones overflow the line.

florui.css: .p { width: 260px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .tag { padding: 0 10px; border: 2px solid #3355cc; margin: 0 8px; background-color: #dfe6ff; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 3.35% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 7.02% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
